name: skills
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins: adversarial audits, planning workflows, asset generation, on-device ML, and more.

plugins.name: bug-audit
plugins.description: Adversarial bug-finding with parallel hunter/skeptic/referee trios. Catches logic errors, race conditions, edge cases, and other quality problems.

plugins.name: perf-audit
plugins.description: Performance counterpart to bug-audit, using the same adversarial hunter/skeptic/referee trios. Targets slow queries, memory leaks, N+1s, and scalability bottlenecks.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Adversarial white-box vulnerability research — finders, disprovers, referees audit source code for novel exploitable bugs.

plugins.name: security-pentest
plugins.description: Adversarial black-box penetration testing — finders, disprovers, referees probe live targets for exploitable vulnerabilities.

plugins.name: security-reverse
plugins.description: Binary reverse engineering — decompile ELF, PE, Mach-O, and firmware binaries to C using Ghidra for security auditing.

plugins.name: code-simplify
plugins.description: Reviews recent code changes for dead code, missed abstractions, readability issues, and inefficiencies, then fixes what it finds.

plugins.name: exhaustive-search
plugins.description: Parallel agent teams that search an entire space exhaustively. Every item gets checked, nothing sampled or skipped.

plugins.name: deep-planner
plugins.description: Multi-agent planner for large implementation tasks. Produces numbered plan files covering research, review, and parallel execution phases.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Drives a feature from requirements to merged PR: planning, parallel implementation, review, audit, and landing.

plugins.name: worktree-manager
plugins.description: Manage git worktrees so multiple agents can work on the same repo in parallel without stepping on each other.

plugins.name: graphite
plugins.description: Stacked PR workflow through the Graphite CLI. Creates branches, submits PRs, merges, syncs, and manages stacks via gt.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Editing pass that strips AI-generated writing patterns: inflated language, promotional filler, giveaway vocabulary, and lifeless structure.

plugins.name: freshen
plugins.description: Parallel agents scan for stale comments, docstrings, TODOs, and docs, then correct factual inaccuracies automatically.

plugins.name: asset-gen
plugins.description: Generate images, sound effects, music, video, SVGs, and 3D models through Gemini, ElevenLabs, and Meshy AI.

plugins.name: model-quantization
plugins.description: Model quantization and format conversion across AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF, ONNX, CoreML, ExecuTorch, and HuggingFace.

plugins.name: coreml-optimization
plugins.description: Apple Neural Engine optimization for iOS and macOS, including model conversion, ANE targeting, split einsum, quantization, and on-device deployment.

plugins.name: android-acceleration
plugins.description: On-device AI inference for Android targeting NPUs, GPUs, and DSPs. Covers ExecuTorch, QNN, NeuroPilot, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime Mobile, and Gemini Nano.

plugins.name: ios-debugging
plugins.description: iOS simulator control: launching apps, navigating screens, inspecting UI, and reading logs. Works with Expo, React Native, and native Swift.

plugins.name: gh-cli
plugins.description: Route GitHub operations through authenticated gh CLI instead of web fetches. Fixes rate limits and private repo 404s.

plugins.name: skill-improver
plugins.description: Review and fix Claude Code skill files. Catches broken frontmatter, ambiguous instructions, and prompt anti-patterns.

plugins.name: startup-namer
plugins.description: Brainstorms startup names and checks viability: domain availability, trademark conflicts, SEO potential, WHOIS data, and domain hacks.
